mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES rebounds after a sharp dip, commuting and adjacent errand trips should recover within four weeks and lift RETAIL_REC above the prior four-week mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its last-28-day mean within 28 days after a sustained WEEKPLACES recovery lasting two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while TRANSIT remains deeply suppressed, shopping shifts toward local and neighborhood outlets, pushing RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -35 for two consecutive weeks while RESIDENTIAL stays above +5
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior four-week average despite the high-RESIDENTIAL, low-TRANSIT condition persisting for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in GROCERY_PHARM is a short-run substitution signal for discretionary shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC should fall in the following week as nonessential visits are deferred.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM crosses above 0 after being negative the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline in the week after GROCERY_PHARM moves from below 0 to above 0.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening mobility restrictions, simultaneous weakness in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals reduced exposure to central retail areas, which lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not lower than the prior four-week mean over the next 28 days while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain depressed.

mechanism_narrative: A positive PARKS spike diverts weekend outing time from indoor retail to outdoor recreation, so RETAIL_REC should weaken over the next two weeks after parks activity rises sharply.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above 0 after a week below -20
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to fall below its last-28-day mean within two weeks after PARKS moves from strongly negative to positive.

mechanism_narrative: When both GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES weaken together, the city is losing everyday foot traffic that anchors discretionary shopping, so RETAIL_REC should decline over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall below its previous four-week average after four weeks of concurrent weakness in GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in RESIDENTIAL indicates more time spent near home, which should reduce discretionary retail visits with a one-week lag and keep RETAIL_REC below its prior mean.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above +6 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline in the week after RESIDENTIAL stays above +6 for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT is recovering but WORKPLACES remains depressed, the rebound reflects essential travel rather than consumer shopping, so RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls over the next two to four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by at least 5 points week-on-week while WORKPLACES stays below -20
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-28-day mean within two to four weeks after TRANSIT improves while WORKPLACES remains depressed.
